title: chaerophyllum novae-zelandiae
intro: Chaerophyllum novae-zelandiae, commonly known as New Zealand umbrella parsley, is a perennial herb native to New Zealand and parts of Australia. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of New Zealand umbrella parsley are attributed to its ability to soothe digestive issues, reduce inflammation, and support immune function. Bioactive constituents, including polyphenolic compounds and essential oils, are responsible for the plant's medicinal properties.
